description: A TypeScript source file defining detailed help text and metadata for various configuration fields used in the openclaw project. It exports a constant record of help strings for configuration keys, including media, audio, gateway, discovery, tools, web, and many other components, along with imported constants for media audio fields and talk defaults.

methods.name: describeTalkSilenceTimeoutDefaults
methods.description: Imported function used to generate default talk silence timeout description string in help text.
